title: Supply Chain Attack on jfrog_quotes
technical_mechanism: -- # `jfrog_quotes` was removed from crates.io for malicious code `jfrog_quotes` was part of a campaign that attempted to exfiltrate environmental data from the host. The malicious crate had 1 version published in January 2025; and had no evidence of actual usage. This crate had no dependencies on crat
